ex5p_role: pilot and failure diagnosis; all designs are development, no held-out claim

policy.fallback: unique-net RR wire growth if no native delay increase
policy.target: first moved instance belonging to a feedback witness net
policy.radius: Manhattan x/y/subtile displacement no greater than failed target move

acceptance: strict native (wirelength, CPD) lexicographic improvement and both at most 102% of initial legal baseline
cost: all failed work and native validation retained in subprocess wall time; common conversion charged equally
limits: not equal search budgets across modes
